links.outcome: Readability (FRE, FKGL) of LLM answers to parents' pediatric dysphagia questions
links.effect: Even the most readable model (Gemini) had FRE 48.7 ± 9.9 and FKGL 10.1 ± 1.6, so answers were written at roughly a 10th-grade level.
links.quote: In terms of readability, Gemini achieved the highest scores (FRE = 48.7 ± 9.9 and FKGL = 10.1 ± 1.6).

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates and compares the accuracy, readability, and information quality of three commercial LLMs (ChatGPT-4, Copilot, Gemini) responding to pediatric dysphagia questions for parental education without testing an explicit deployment practice.
